title: minimal display
shortDescription: The smallest setup of the stage layer: a Display, one Stage2D and a StageRenderer
description: A `Display` takes over the `<canvas resize-to="window">`, creates the renderer and runs the frame loop. A `Stage2D` with a `ParallaxProjection('xy|bottom-left', {width, height, fit: 'contain'})` lays a fixed rectangle of 2288 × 3264 units into the window, whatever its aspect ratio, and a `StageRenderer` clears the canvas and draws the stage. The image itself is an ordinary three.js `Sprite`, its texture loaded by a `TextureFactory` with the classes `nearest`, `flipy` and `srgb`. `display`, `stage` and `stageRenderer` hang on `window` for a look in the devtools.
